interpretations: Per-account average transaction amount
Average the raw `trans.amount` values (unsigned) for each account, over all of its transactions, including VYBER.
Average signed amounts: PRIJEM positive and VYDAJ negative, with VYBER treated as a withdrawal (negative).
Average signed amounts: PRIJEM positive and VYDAJ negative, with VYBER rows excluded because their direction is unstated.
Average signed amounts: PRIJEM positive and VYDAJ negative, with VYBER treated as positive.
Average only credit (PRIJEM) amounts per account.
Average only withdrawal (VYDAJ) amounts per account.
Accounts included
Only accounts with at least one transaction are included.
Accounts with no transactions are included with an average of 0.
Accounts with no transactions are included with a NULL average, which is ignored in the regional average.
Regional figure
The regional figure is the unweighted mean of its accounts' per-account averages.
The regional figure is the transaction-weighted average, meaning the mean of all transactions in the region. This is not what was described, but it is a possible reading.
A region is determined by the district of the account's branch (`account.district_id` → `district.A3`), not the client's district.
Average across all regions (threshold and ratio denominator)
The mean of the regional figures, each region weighted equally (including only regions that have accounts).
The mean of the regional figures, with regions that have no accounts or transactions included as 0.
The mean of all per-account averages across all accounts, with each account weighted equally.
The mean of all transaction amounts across all transactions.
The threshold is the mean of regional figures, while the ratio denominator is a different "average figure" (for example, the account-level mean).
Filter
A region qualifies only if its figure is strictly greater than the all-region average.
A region qualifies if its figure is greater than or equal to the all-region average.
Output columns
"How much it exceeds" is the absolute difference (region figure − all-region average).
"How much it exceeds" is the percentage excess, ((figure − avg) / avg) × 100.
"How much it exceeds" is the relative excess, (figure / avg) − 1.
"Its figure divided by the average" is the plain ratio (figure / avg).
"Its figure divided by the average" is expressed as a percentage (figure / avg × 100).
Output columns are region (`A3`), figure, excess and ratio, with no rounding, in full precision.
The output is ordered by figure descending.
The output has no particular order.
Missing interpretations:

Average signed amounts: PRIJEM positive and VYDAJ negative, with VYBER treated as the sign its own operation implies (it is cash withdrawal, so negative), matching the type-based rule only for the VYDAJ rows.
Per-account average uses only accounts that have at least one disposition or client (accounts joined via `disp`), which could drop accounts or duplicate them across multiple dispositions.
Accounts whose `district_id` has no matching `district` row are excluded from the regional figures (inner join) rather than assigned to a NULL region.
Accounts with no transactions are excluded from the regional average, but their regions still appear in the all-region average as 0.

The regional figure is the mean of the per-account averages, but the "average across all regions" counts each distinct `A3` region once even if the same region name appears under multiple districts (as opposed to per-district grouping).
"How much it exceeds" is the ratio minus 1 expressed as a percentage, i.e. (figure / avg − 1) × 100.
Integer division is applied in the averages, truncating decimals, because `trans.amount` is an INTEGER column.
queries: SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) FROM trans GROUP BY account_id
SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) FROM trans GROUP BY account_id
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) FROM trans
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) FROM trans WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
SELECT type, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount ELSE amount END) FROM trans GROUP BY type;
SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) FROM trans WHERE type = 'PRIJEM' GROUP BY account_id
